description: Read a public purchase receipt: what was reported as approved, scope, price cap, merchant, proofs, payments, content hash, approver_confirmation, pay_allowed, and public_view. external_payment_ref is the latest recorded payment ref, or the approval-time ref when no payment is recorded. paid_before_confirmation and over_cap are true when any recorded payment has that flag. Those three fields are derived at read time and do not change the signed row. status is unconfirmed, confirmed, or declined. confirmed means the person with access to the contact clicked Confirm, with time and channel. unconfirmed is the default and is not a verification of the person. pay_allowed is true only when approver_confirmation.status is confirmed, or when no approver_contact was given and the price cap is under RECEIPT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD (default 100, in the price cap currency). Agents must poll get_receipt and pay only when pay_allowed is true. When public_view is redacted, the approver is initials, the agent name is Agent, contacts are omitted, and payment refs and proof values are on file plus the last 4 characters. BotSupply does not move the money. The approver name is what the calling agent reported. No API key. The raw contact, confirm link, and edit token are not included. Poll this to learn the click result. Same as GET /v1/receipts/:id.
name: get_receipt
title: Get purchase receipt
